headline: 本周影剧：爱情假说领跑，龙族热播
summary: 本周影市由《爱情假说》《野兽之心》等领跑，待映《复仇者联盟5》受关注；剧集端《权力的游戏前传：龙族》《瑞克和莫蒂》《菜鸟老警》热播，待播《幻视任务》《女巫团学院》引期待。

industryHighlights.text: 《爱情假说》《野兽之心》领跑本周电影热作。
industryHighlights.en: Love Hypothesis and Beast Heart lead this week's movie hits.

industryHighlights.text: 《权力的游戏前传：龙族》《瑞克和莫蒂》《菜鸟老警》持续热播。
industryHighlights.en: House of the Dragon, Rick and Morty and The Rookie remain hot.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影包括《复仇者联盟5》《猫鼬》《挖掘者》。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films include Avengers 5, Mongoose and Digger.

industryHighlights.text: 待播剧包括《幻视任务》《女巫团学院》《律界战争》。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming series include Vision Quest, Witch Academy and Legal War.

headlineEn: This Week: Love Hypothesis Leads, Dragon Heats Up
summaryEn: This week's film slate is led by Love Hypothesis and Beast Heart, with Avengers 5 upcoming; on TV, House of the Dragon, Rick and Morty and The Rookie are hot, while Vision Quest and Witch Academy draw anticipation.
